architectural-decision-records.why: records the portable-hook + refuse-footgun decision and its limits
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0051: esk-init writes a ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} hook when the emitter is inside the target, and refuses (exit 2) to commit a machine-specific path into a git-tracked settings.json unless overridden
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the fix ships discrimination tests for both halves
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added esk-init tests: portable form written (no machine path), committed-footgun refused (exit 2, nothing written), gitignored allowed, --allow-absolute overrides; the 31 pre-existing cases still pass
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code paths, so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: fixture-driven tests build a standalone skills repo and git-tracked/gitignored targets and run the real installer; the right level for an installer, no integration surface beyond that
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the installer writes a hook command into another repos settings and shells out to git
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: it refuses to commit a machine-specific executable path (dead-hook/footgun) into a tracked file, uses spawnSync with array args (no shell) for the git detection, and fails open to local only when git is unavailable
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the changed .mjs; the behavior is pinned as executable cases
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: the portable-form and refuse-footgun behaviors are covered by discrimination tests that fail if either is removed
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the limits rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that the portable form needs the emitter vendored in the target, and that the git-tracked detection is best-effort and fails open to local
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: will run a fresh-context judge-arch review over the esk-init change, the tests, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

release-deployment-safety.why: a local installer change; nothing deployed, migrated, or released

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: CI/dev tooling; no system, data, or resilience architecture change

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or migration

arch-encode.why: a fix to an installer, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
